opportunities.name: Propose hotel to colleague with converted price
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for hotels in {city} from {check_in} to {check_out}, pick a hotel, convert its EUR total to {target_currency} on xe.com, then draft an email to {recipient} proposing the hotel with both prices.
steps: Open booking.com and dismiss cookie/sign-in popups
Enter {city} in the destination field and choose the first suggestion
Open the date picker, go to the right month, and select {check_in} and {check_out}
Click Search and scan the results; note the chosen hotel's name and EUR total price
Open the xe.com currency converter with EUR as the 'from' currency
Enter the EUR price and set the 'to' currency to {target_currency}; note the converted amount
Open the New message compose form
Set To = {recipient}, Subject = 'Hotel for {city}, {check_in}-{check_out}'
Set Body = 'Hi {name}, proposed hotel: {hotel}, {price} EUR (about {converted} {currency}). OK to book?'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-20; Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South 818 EUR -> 915.34 USD; maria@example.com
Milan, Dec 1-4; BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti 264 EUR -> 46,794 JPY; kenji@example.com
Amsterdam, Jan 12-15; Jan Luyken Amsterdam 577 EUR -> 487.44 GBP; aisha@example.com

opportunities.name: City heads-up email (weather + strike news)
opportunities.description: Look up the 10-day forecast for {city} on weather.com, search BBC for '{city} strike', then email {recipient} a heads-up with the forecast for {day} and the latest headline.
steps: On weather.com, open the location search and type {city}
Select the matching city and open the 10 Day tab
Note the high/low and conditions for {day}
On bbc.com, open search and search for '{city} strike'
Note the top result's headline and date
Open the New message compose form
Set To = {recipient}, Subject = 'Heads-up: {city} on {day}'
Set Body = 'Hi {name}, {city} on {day}: {high}/{low}, {conditions}. Latest news: {headline} ({date}).'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: Berlin, Saturday, raj@example.com; 58/44 Partly Cloudy; Students strike across Germany
Madrid, Monday, sofia@example.com; 64/50 Partly Cloudy; Villa eye Endrick loan deal
London, Thursday, tom@example.com; 70/56 Cloudy; School support staff strike over pay

opportunities.name: Traveler visa + holiday note
opportunities.description: Look up the Wikipedia article 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens' for {destination_country}, look up {destination_country}'s holidays in {month} on timeanddate.com, and save a note that sums up both.
steps: On Wikipedia, search 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens' and open the article
Find the row for {destination_country} and note the visa requirement and allowed stay
On timeanddate.com, open Holidays and search for or pick {destination_country}
Read the upcoming holidays in {month}
Open the Notes page and type '{nationality} traveler to {country}: {visa info}. Holidays in {month}: {holidays}' in New note
Save the note

instances.values: Indian -> Japan, December: eVisa; no national holidays, Dec 31 bank holiday
Brazilian -> Canada, November: visa required (eTA possible by air); Nov 11 Remembrance Day
Nigerian -> United Kingdom, May: May 4 Early May Bank Holiday, May 25 Spring Bank Holiday
